title: Product of Array Except Self II

content.problemStatement:
Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is the product of all elements except nums[i].

Do not use division.

solution.approach: Compute prefix products and suffix products to calculate product of all elements except self in O(N).

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
    if toks:
        n = toks[0]
        arr = toks[1:1+n]
        pref = [1] * n
        suff = [1] * n
        for i in range(1, n): pref[i] = pref[i-1] * arr[i-1]
        for i in range(n-2, -1, -1): suff[i] = suff[i+1] * arr[i+1]
        print(" ".join(str(pref[i] * suff[i]) for i in range(n)))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

editorial.overview: Prefix product stores product of elements before index i. Suffix product stores product after index i. Result[i] = pref[i] * suff[i].
editorial.approach: Compute prefix products and suffix products to calculate product of all elements except self in O(N).
